answer: A bell-yard licenses only one striker key per pour. The key bonds 48 units, draws pit P=H(key||pour) mod 77, and from minute (hash mod 12)+8 has 16 minutes to hang a unique onyx clapper so the third partial hits a 21-cent bin. It first commits H(clapper||verse||key) of one verse from the posted fable; two pit-wardens on a karst-cut gallery replay the tape and attest only if the serial is unused and the verse opens the commit. A missed window, reused clapper, or bad verse burns 17 units and benches the key 8 epochs; a warden signing two pits in one pour is fined 74 units and silenced 11 epochs.
